svg.title: Rohan Koriya, Software Developer
svg.desc: ASCII portrait of Rohan Koriya. Rohan Koriya, Software Developer. I build real-world web products with the MERN stack: MongoDB, Express, React and Node.js. I enjoy solving problems more than memorizing solutions, and every project teaches me something new.
